name: InterContinental Fiji Golf Resort & Spa
positioning: Beachfront resort on Natadola Bay on Viti Levu, laid out like a traditional Fijian village in tropical gardens, with an on-site championship golf course and spa
best_for: Couples who want a beach stay with private outdoor space and romantic dining
Golfers who want an oceanfront championship course on site
Families who want kids' activities and babysitting at a beach resort

facts.text: The resort faces a sandy beach on Natadola Bay and looks out to the South Pacific.
The resort echoes the layout of a traditional Fijian village, with rooms and suites spread across 35 acres of beachside tropical gardens.
Every room has a generous outdoor living space with a daybed and the resort's signature Cleopatra bath.
Spa InterContinental offers Eastern and Western treatments infused with local herbs and honey.
The spa has hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
The Natadola Bay Championship Golf Course is an 18-hole course on site, with coral reefs and the Pacific Ocean as the backdrop on 15 of the 18 holes.
Kama Lounge hosts a nightly torch-lighting ceremony at sunset, with Polynesian fire dancing, island dance and traditional meke.
Navo Restaurant overlooks the lagoon and Navo island, serving dishes like Yasawas Island lobster kokoda and Natadola mud crab salad from a glass show kitchen.
Snorkeling, scuba diving and shark diving can be done at Natadola Bay.
The resort offers children's activities, babysitting and a nanny for hire.
Breakfast is included with the stay.

highlights.text: The resort is laid out like a traditional Fijian village, with rooms and suites spread across 35 acres of beachside tropical gardens.
Every room has a generous outdoor living space with a daybed and a signature Cleopatra bath.
The on-site 18-hole Natadola Bay Championship Golf Course has coral reefs and the Pacific Ocean as the backdrop on 15 of its 18 holes.
Each evening Kama Lounge holds a torch-lighting ceremony at sunset, followed by Polynesian fire dancing, island dance and traditional meke.
One beachside cabana is set aside each evening for a private dinner for two, served by a personal waiter on the shores of Natadola Bay.

considerations.text: The resort is about 45 kilometers from Nadi International Airport, so arrival means a road transfer.
Condé Nast Traveler notes the drive from the airport might be a drawback for guests heading on to an offshore resort.
WhataHotel notes there are limited dining options outside the resort.
